Method of Attack: Automated mechanism to maintain a persistent infection by respawning under slightly different names after removal
Impacted Systems: Developers' systems running Python projects, particularly those involving AI and LLMs, Discord, Telegram, and Twitter bots
Attack Vector: Typosquatting to mimic legitimate package names
Automated checks and uploads of new packages upon removal of the old ones
Indicators of Compromise: Suspicious pip install commands in Python scripts
Packages with benign initial versions followed by malicious updates
Encrypted payloads within seemingly legitimate code
Rapid respawning of similar package names after takedowns
